label: Check for prompt injection
description: Checks text for prompt injection: attempts to override the AI's instructions, fake system messages, hidden or encoded instructions, and requests for secrets. Uses fixed checks; plug in an AI model to also ask it.

inputs.name: model
inputs.description: Optional: an AI model that also judges the text. The check fails when either the fixed checks or the model flag it.

outputs.name: next
outputs.description: Where to go after the check: connect the next step, or Finish.

input.title: Text to check
input.description: The data field to check. For the conversation (messages) the newest message is checked.

on_fail.title: When it fails
on_fail.description: stop = end the run with an error that says why; flag = carry on and save the verdict for a later step to branch on.

flag_output.title: Save yes/no in
flag_output.description: Optional: a true/false field that is true when the check fails. Branch on it with Choose a path, e.g. state.flagged == true.

report_output.title: Save the details in
report_output.description: Optional: a field that receives what was found and why (never the personal data itself).

threshold.title: Sensitivity threshold
threshold.description: The check fails when the risk score (0 to 1) reaches this. Lower catches more but has more false alarms.
